name: DianSheng 3x3 4-Corner Hexagonal Dipyramid V2 (Tiled)
description: This unique 3x3 shape mod from DianSheng features a four-corner hexagonal dipyramid design and a matte tiled finish for a sleek, refined look. It turns like a standard 3x3 but offers a visually striking challenge. Packaged in a premium magnetic box with a built-in geared lift mechanism, the puzzle rises smoothly as you open the box, delivering an elegant and satisfying unboxing experience.
